s: Today we talk about food and cooking at home.
What is in your soup, Maya?
I put garlic in the soup, and I put garlic in the rice too.
Hot garlic bread is my favourite.
Garlic bread is hot and tasty.
But careful, Lena, the bread is hot.
Do you cook a hamburger today too?
Yes, I cook one hamburger for you and one hamburger for me.
A hot hamburger with cheese, please.
Yes, it is hot and delicious.
Oh, this box next to you looks heavy.
The box has potatoes and rice in it.
A heavy box is hard work for one person.
Two friends can lift a heavy box together.
Friends, let me tell you something while we cook.

Now, what do we have for dessert?
I have green grapes and purple grapes.
Then we can eat the grapes together.
Do you eat grapes every day?
Grapes are good after a hot lunch.
After this hot hamburger, cold grapes are perfect.
Maya, your soup is still hot.
Please be careful with the hot pot.
And the pot is heavy too, so I use two hands.
A heavy pot and hot soup need care.
On Monday I cook soup, on Tuesday I make rice, and on Friday we always eat a hamburger together.
And I always bring grapes on Friday.
You wash them, and they are ready.
Food words are easy to learn in the kitchen.
You see the garlic, you touch the heavy box, you feel the hot soup.
And then you eat the hamburger!
Short lessons every day help a lot.
Five small words today, five more tomorrow, and soon you know many words.
Before we eat, one more thing, friends.
